contracts: (The boundary validator rejects the user-sandbox write attempt and the target remains unchanged.) AND (The governance check rejects with a Phase-boundary diagnostic, the protected target remains byte-identical, and no accepted write receipt is produced.)
selector_intents: Governance incorrectly accepts a write targeting a Phase service boundary.
Run the Toolchain scope-boundary negative validator with a user-sandbox write target and require an allowed write to fail the validator.
The attempted protected write changes, creates, deletes, or renames a Phase service file.
Validation evaluates a different or sanitized target instead of the requested Phase service path.
